verdict.line: You lose if you eat free Corrosive Charge poke before level 3 and let his R execute you while low; you win if you wall off Disdain and all-in behind the Maiden from level 6 on.

brief.thesis: Urgot is a ranged poke and skirmish champion who can out-trade melee Yorick with Q (Corrosive Charge) at 800 range before Yorick has a wall to hide behind. Once W (Dark Procession) is online at level 3, it directly neutralizes Disdain (E), since Urgot cannot dash through the wall, turning his only engage/disengage tool into a liability. With a near-even 50.4% head-to-head over 804 games but lane and solo-kill advantage on Yorick's side, this is a mistake-punishing skill matchup, exactly as the live tip states.

theirWindow.when: before level 3, wall not up yet
theirWindow.what: Urgot free-pokes with Q (Corrosive Charge) from 800 range and threatens to follow a hit with Disdain (E) to shove you toward his side. Stay behind minions so the charge has to clear your wave first, and don't walk up for trades until you have W to answer his dash.

yourWindow.when: he dashes Disdain or Purge whiffs
yourWindow.what: Drop W (Dark Procession) the instant he commits Disdain so he's trapped on your side of the wall, then land E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred, slow, and mark before finishing with Q (Last Rites) autos. From level 6, summon R (Eulogy of the Isles) first so the Maiden's bonus damage closes his range advantage during the all-in.

powerCurve.note: Corrosive Charge outranges your sustain tools
W wall now hard-counters his Disdain dash
Maiden plus Mourning Mist closes the gap
Purge cooldown drops near zero, trade carefully
Trinity Force spike wins extended sieges

start.why: Sustains through his safe Q poke (50.3% win rate over 596 games) so you reach level 3 and your wall with health in hand.

boots.why: Cuts down the repeated physical pokes from Echoing Flames and Purge's auto-heavy channel, the most common damage source he leans on (50% win rate, 76% pick).

core.why: Gives you the burst, sustain, and move speed to actually close the gap on a kiting ranged champion.
Stacks armor shred on top of Mourning Mist's reduction so your all-ins after the wall trap hit far harder.
Cooldown reduction loops Q's heal and E's slow faster, letting you out-sustain his poke in extended skirmishes (58.7% win rate over 63 games as this full path).

situational.when: he's kiting with Disdain cooldowns up and you need the slow to pin him down
you're ahead and want to survive his R execute threshold during all-ins
the lane stabilizes and you want to split-push, since Urgot struggles to solo-siege your wall-reinforced turret

runes.keystoneWhy: This matchup is decided by extended all-ins once you trap him behind the wall, and Conqueror ramps through exactly those fights, matching the 55.7% win rate this page posts in the matchup.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite posts the best win rate here (53.6% over 31.9% pick) because it secures kills the moment you trap him behind W; take Flash + Teleport instead if you'd rather prioritize wave management and scaling into your item spikes.

playing.title: Trade behind minions
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge (Q) is an 800-range skillshot that explodes on impact. Stay behind your wave early so it has to clear minions first and you see the cast before it reaches you.

playing.title: Wall his Disdain
playing.detail: The instant Urgot dashes Disdain (E) at you from level 3 on, drop W (Dark Procession) so he's trapped on your side; he cannot cross the wall with that dash, turning his engage into a death sentence.

playing.title: Track Purge cooldown
playing.detail: Purge (W) drops from 12s to 0s cooldown as he ranks it and slows him while he channels. Bait it early, then punish the self-slow with Q (Last Rites) for free damage and healing.

playing.title: All-in off Maiden
playing.detail: From level 6 on, summon R (Eulogy of the Isles) before you commit, then land a fresh E (Mourning Mist) mark; the Maiden's bonus damage closes the DPS gap his range normally gives him.

playing.title: Respect his execute range
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death (R) impales from 2500 range and can execute you once you're low. Don't dive below the threshold where a landed R kills, especially after he's traded freely with Q.

playing.title: Hold E for the commit
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's armor shred and slow matter most in a fight you're already winning. Save it for the all-in rather than trading it away on a poke exchange he can just walk out of.

playing.title: Punish a whiffed Disdain
playing.detail: Disdain's cooldown runs 16 to 14 seconds at later ranks. Once he dashes in and trampling fails or he's walled off, he has no escape tool left; that's your window to commit Q, E, and autos.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and all win rates above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability readings, timings, and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (Q) while hitting him with [E]. Whoever makes more mistakes will die. After reaching level 6, use [R] and hit him with [E]. He cannot go through [W] with his (E), so trap him inside whenever you can.
